map.分别评估面部各区域动态皱纹（表情时出现）与静态皱纹（静止时可见），指导肉毒素与填: Assess dynamic wrinkles (appear with expression) and static wrinkles (visible at rest) by facial region to guide Botox and filler planning
map.早干预：动态纹期用肉毒素可延缓变静态，理解「早打不是滥用」。: Early intervention: Botox in the dynamic phase can delay becoming static—understand "early treatment is not overuse."
map.方案分层：静态深纹需联合填充/射频，而非单打肉毒素。: Layered planning: deep static wrinkles need combined filler/RF, not Botox alone.
map.科普解释：让求美者看懂为什么「同一种纹治法不同」。: Education: help clients understand why "the same wrinkle needs different treatment."
map.：输入：皱眉出现深沟、静息仍留浅沟 → 判动静混合，建议肉毒素+局部刺激胶原，纯: : Input: frowning shows a deep groove, rest still leaves a shallow groove → judged mixed dynamic/static; suggest Botox plus local collagen stimulation, as Botox alone has limited effect on the static segment.
map.动态纹不理会怎样？: What if dynamic wrinkles are ignored?
map.反复折叠可渐成静态不可逆纹，早干预更省事。: Repeated folding can gradually become irreversible static wrinkles; early intervention is easier.
map.对静态段效果有限，常需联合其他手段。: Limited effect on the static segment; usually needs combined approaches.
map.本评估定方案吗？: Does this assessment set the plan?
map.不定。仅为动静区分，治疗由医师定。: No. It only distinguishes dynamic/static; the physician determines treatment.
